definitions.population: Callbacks that changed the actual scene render counter; full instrumentation also cross-checks actual draw calls. Startup/warmup excluded by saved index; includes the original 150 ms drain after actions.
definitions.latency: performance.now at callback entry minus timestamp immediately before native RAF registration; native RAF timestamp is retained but not subtracted.
definitions.callback: CPU wall span around actual callback; no GPU timer query.
definitions.scenario: Ten seconds alternating trusted Look left/right mouse clicks; resize1440->1380 every tenth click and back on twentieth; same semantic idle state and projection across densities.
